eval_name: Choose reuse, create, or current checkout correctly
prompt:
I have a task to fix a bug on branch feature/login. There is already a worktree
at /repo/.worktrees/login owned by another worker, and my current checkout has
unrelated uncommitted changes. Should I reuse that worktree, create a new one,
or just work in the current checkout? Explain your choice and what worktrees share.
